recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while NQ is closed; the Sunday Globex reopening is the primary conditional risk checkpoint.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress ahead of Sunday NQ reopening
body: NQ is closed, so no current one-way price path can be observed. Saudi and Gulf equities weakened after Houthi attack claims, while Friday's Nasdaq gain was semiconductor-led despite negative breadth, Treasury yields above 5% and crude above $100. Higher planned Aramco Gulf exports and unchanged China lending benchmarks partly offset shock risk. Tail remains low pending live price structure.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail rose from 11% to 16% during Friday before settling at 15% through the closed weekend hours. Stress rose from 83% to 93% and then stabilized near 91%; every published hourly state remained green / EA_ON with dominantMode normal.
outlookSummary: NQ remains closed until the scheduled 22:00 UTC Sunday Globex reopening. Tail stays below the blocking threshold in the base case, with conditional WATCH concentrated from 21:45 UTC through 01:00 UTC around gap size, first-pullback quality, repeated extension and cross-asset confirmation. Extreme Stress reflects geopolitical and rates/oil uncertainty, not an observed persistent one-way price path.
